_comment: The Conan side of this project runs on two tracks.
Track 1 (cci): everything ConanCenter carries, resolved by version from the configured remotes.
Track 2 (mount): a recipe ConanCenter does not carry, or a prebuilt artifact for it, dropped at a
path this file names. The path is outside the repository on purpose -- a recipe's job is to carry a
download URL and an upstream sha256, and the plan keeps those out of the version library.
A missing mount is not an error: the leg that needs it says so and is skipped, and every other leg
is unaffected. That is what lets a clean clone build without the mount.

mounts.if_missing: the vendor leg is skipped and says which mount it wanted; the default leg never asks for it
